title: Export Business: Top 5 Markets for Bangladesh (FY26) #Shorts
hook: 'Export business in Bangladesh? Save these five markets' — save-this list + quiz cards flipping
visual: 3D globe (studio night, routes from Bangladesh to US/DE/UK/ES/NL, rot0 -3.4, slow push) for the hook; quiz flip card #1 USA + $9.05B counter (e_sky); two flip cards DE/UK + bar chart (e_gold); 3D port at dusk (flyby cam) behind #4 Spain/#5 Netherlands cards + ≈51% ring; kit CTA.
script: Export business in Bangladesh? Save these five markets.
One: the USA, about nine billion dollars last year.
Two and three: Germany and the UK, nearly four point seven billion each.
Then Spain and the Netherlands. Five markets, about half of all exports.
Pick one, then list your products on Exportain, and let buyers there find you.
lessons: Globe needed rot0 (new r3d option) to face Bangladesh; lookY 2.5 + z 78->60 frames it under the headline. Render 3D at 1080x1920 takes ~20 min on 2 CPUs; never run stills while rendering (screenshot timeouts) — setup now sets 180 s page timeout.
